selection: All publisher-labeled reference objects from the first selected Level1 frame, compared with first/middle/last fixed Level3 frames, for both environments and all three categories at Lighting1. No selection by matcher output.
annotation_provenance: Publisher LabelFusion pose/mask records and ChatGPT visual review of all selected observations; not an independent human assessment. Five absent targets were visually checked across all three views, not inferred only from missing labels.
dataset: UW Indoor Scenes (UW-IS) Occluded v1, Figshare 20506506, file36708684, CC BY4.0
attribution: Ekta U. Samani, Xingjian Yang, Srivatsa Grama Satyanarayana and Ashis G. Banerjee (2022)
scope: Six correlated scene-condition cases from two environments and a shared object pool. Independent of prior Countback development sources, not a representative or statistically independent 34-object benchmark. Reference crops use publisher masks; observation masks/poses and truth never enter the matcher. No tuning on these cases. Support coverage is not localization/identity accuracy. Full plan, annotations and review ledger are retained in the downloadable evidence packet under the fingerprints above.
